title: SCORCH: Spatiotemporal Classification of Regional Compound Heatwaves (software, version 1.0.0)

creators.name: Bouhamad, Fawaz
creators.affiliation: Department of Agricultural and Biological Engineering, University of Florida, Gainesville, Florida, USA

creators.name: Najibi, Nasser
creators.affiliation: Department of Agricultural and Biological Engineering, University of Florida, Gainesville, Florida, USA

description:
SCORCH identifies regionally extensive compound heatwaves in daily maximum temperature fields. In five stages it detects local heatwaves at every grid cell, selects regionally extensive days, groups the heatwave cells of each day with DBSCAN, fits a PCA ellipse and a temperature-weighted centroid to every cluster, and joins consecutive days into compound events of four types.

This record archives the GitHub release of the software: the Python package and scorch command, the R scripts of the power-law and log-Gaussian Cox process models, a synthetic demo, tests, documentation, and the catalogs, tables and figures of the study of the Eastern Mediterranean and Middle East (1940-2025). The processed input dataset is a separate Zenodo record (version 1.0.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21717874).
notes: Code is GPL-3.0-only.
